description: Call callbackfn once for each entry of array, in index order, and return a new array of the results, with each result that is an array replaced by its entries (map then flat(1)). A result that is not an array is one entry, so a callback can return zero, one or more entries.

parameters.description: The array to walk. A string is not walked as an array: write [...value] to walk its characters.
parameters.name: array

parameters.dataTypeParameter: (value: any, index?: integer, array?: array) => any
parameters.description: Called for each entry of array; an array result adds its entries, any other result adds itself. A script function is called with (value, index, array); a built-in function is called with the value alone, since its other parameters have their own meanings.
parameters.name: callbackfn

returns.description: A new array of the results, one level flattened.
